caption: A coin is pushed under the edge of a rug, and when the rug is lifted the coin lies where it was pushed.

sa.check: A coin is pushed under the edge of a rug.
The coin lies where it was pushed.
The push comes first, then the lift, then the coin is seen.

pc.expect: The coin is hidden while covered and is the same coin, in that spot, when the rug is lifted.
pc.fail: It is gone; or a different coin; or it is elsewhere.

pc.expect: The coin is not visible through the rug.
pc.fail: It shows through the rug; or passes through the rug; or the rug passes through the coin.

pc.expect: The coin moves only when pushed.
pc.fail: It slides alone; or jumps; or moves under the rug by itself.

pc.expect: The coin lies flat on the floor.
pc.fail: It floats; or stands on edge; or rises into the rug.

pc.expect: One coin and one rug keep their number.
pc.fail: The coin duplicates; or the rug vanishes; or the coin turns into another object.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The rug's pattern and the floor stay the same.
pc.fail: The pattern changes; or the floor changes; or the room rearranges.
